interpretation_guide.mae_interpretation: Mean Absolute Error: On average, the XGBoost prediction deviates by this amount in Lakhs from actual house price. Lower is better.
interpretation_guide.rmse_interpretation: Root Mean Squared Error: Penalizes larger pricing errors more heavily. Lower is better.
interpretation_guide.r2_interpretation: R-squared coefficient of determination: Proportion of price variance explained by sequentially boosted regression trees. Higher is better (1.0 = perfect).
